title.en: An Act Authorizing the Investment of the Immunized Cattle Insurance Fund Established By Act Numbered Twenty-Five Hundred and Forty-Eight.

text.en:
The immunized cattle insurance fund established by Act Numbered Twenty-five hundred and
forty-eight is hereby made available for investment by the Insular Treasurer, with the approval of the
Governor-General, in such loans and securities as are authorized by existing laws for the investment of
deposits in the Postal Savings Bank, or for the investment of the insurance fund, created by Act Numbered
Seventeen hundred and twenty-eight, as amended: Provided, That the rates of interest on all loans made by
authority of this section shall be fixed by the Governor-General.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, February 24, 1916.
